measurement_scope: True workflow measurement. Each run executes the variant's complete workflow sequentially (Submission→Finalization). Total latency is the real wall-clock elapsed time from workflowStart to workflowEnd. Submission=Fabric invoke CreateBuyOrder (--waitForEvent: endorsement+ordering+commit+event). Finalization=Fabric invoke SubmitMatchingResult (--waitForEvent: endorsement+ordering+commit+event). Both include Docker exec IPC overhead.
implementation_note: Enabled stages: Submission + Finalization(SubmitMatchingResult). Chaincode SubmitMatchingResult: idempotency check + base64 format + threshold count check (not full ECDSA verification) + state write.
